Bettina, I couldn't find a date for Pellucid Harbor Logistics changing hands to Kwame. The #coastal-team and #general history I can read doesn't mention an ownership change, and I couldn't find Moss's Coastal digest in the shared files. The only Pellucid mentions in #coastal-team are from February 2026, when Sofia and Kwame were sorting out which PHL rows belong to which account. Those don't say when ownership moved.

For the tracker, Moss is the quickest source, since they wrote the digest. Kwame or Sofia would also know, and the account record in the CRM should carry the effective date. If you send me the digest's date or link, I can check the wording for you.
